description: Open-web discovery is not a LexisNexis “All News” search. Four captured queries, including a Szczecin follow-up, do not exhaust weekly windows, regional outlets or all sectors/provinces; no zero-event conclusion is supported.

topic: Szczecin Oct 28/29 event identity and turnout
description: 24Kurier verifies a public Oct 28 picket but no count; an organizer-network page dated Oct 29 says “today” and estimates >500. Whether it is a distinct next-day event or date error is unresolved; do not merge or assign the count to Oct 28.

Official monthly compilation describes an Oct 8 planned/organizing action, but no contemporaneous event/count was opened in this pass; Nov reporting later is blocked. Onset, actual occurrence and turnout are unknown.
PAP exact target returned HTTP 403; preserve the receipt and do not retry. Search snippet reports about 40 participants, not body evidence.

A limited Gov.pl annual index page view was visible after a later manual check in prior session context, but no exact raw body response survived; this version records only that loss and no substantive findings. Earlier defer remains; the later access check was not retroactive.
